source_id.Description: Subject file prefix in the release (s1-s8)

hemisphere.Description: Implanted hemisphere (side of the subdural grids). Source: Cho et al. 2021, bioRxiv doi:10.1101/2021.02.12.430921, Methods 'Subjects' (left S1, S3, S6, S7; right S2, S4, S5, S8). The deposit's electrode coordinates agree (talairach_alignment/s<N>/orig_brain_model.mat and talairach_tal_brain_model.mat: x > 0 for 76/76, 79/79 (Talairach; 76/79 native), 117/117 and 138/138 electrodes of s2, s4, s5, s8; x < 0 for all electrodes of s1, s3, s7 and 98/114 of s6). Corrected 2026-10-09: version 1 copied the release analysis parameter IsRightHemisphere, which is 'no' for all eight subjects (sourcedata/zenodo-4361654/sub-XX_parameters.json) and is wrong for four of them.

implant_type.Source: doi:10.1101/2021.02.12.430921, Methods 'Subjects' (Ad-Tech / PMT grids, 4 mm platinum-iridium electrodes, 2.3 mm exposed, 10 mm spacing)

n_electrodes_in_brain_model.Description: Electrodes with coordinates in the deposit brain model (rows of tala.electrodes)
